# Data export, retention and deletion

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/api_reference.py from contracts/openapi; do not edit. -->

Base path: `https://<gateway>/governance`. Every call needs an API key or a Studio session (see [Authentication](index.md#authentication)). Request and response fields are in the OpenAPI document, `contracts/openapi/governance.json`.

| Method | Path | What it does | Body | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/v1/lifecycle/delete` | Delete the whole organization. | `DeleteIn` | 202 `RequestOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/lifecycle/export` | Export everything the organization holds, from every service, as one archive. |  | 202 `RequestOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/lifecycle/requests` | List Requests |  | 200 list of `RequestOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/lifecycle/requests/{request_id}` | Get Request |  | 200 `RequestOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/lifecycle/requests/{request_id}/cancel` | Stop a scheduled deletion during its grace period. |  | 200 `RequestOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/lifecycle/requests/{request_id}/download` | Download |  | 200 |
| `GET` | `/v1/retention/runs` | Retention Runs |  | 200 list of `RetentionOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/retention/runs` | Purge what this organization's retention profile says has expired, now (it also runs every night). |  | 202 `RetentionOut` |
